notes.title: Devblog #5
notes.content:
Hey Everyone! 

Feb 13, 2020


Done some major tweaking to enemy balancing.
As time goes on, stronger versions of the enemies will spawn.
Certain difficulties of enemies have been spaced out more, to not feel too overwhelming.
I've extended the time it takes for enemy types to be of their strongest variant.
[list]
[*]Fixed a minor bug on the buy menu with the cost of the last weapon upgrades.
[*]Fixed loading bar percentage starting at 20%, it now starts at 0%.

[/list]
I will keep tweaking the balancing of all enemies along with weapon power. 

Let me know how these changes feel.

notes.title: Devblog #3
notes.content:
Hey Everyone!

This is a fairly large patch, there were a few components I needed to finish before pushing.

Jan 24, 2020

[list]
[*]All abilities now have upgrades! They now last longer and have shorter cooldowns.
[*]The assault rifle is now finally relevant. Along with its normal bullet, it now has a chance of shooting an explosive round, dealing area damage. 
[*]The assault rifle also has upgrades now, increasing its firing speed and the travel speed of the normal bullet.
[*]I've also balanced some of the weapons a bit more.
[*]There's now text above the HP bar showing you your HP value (for debugging purposes) - I've done a few changes to the health system.
[*]There is now a "buy menu" icon on the HUD in-game.
[/list]

The next few days I'll be working on finishing off the steam achievements and any other bugs that appear.
